name: Human Head & Neck Muscular Anatomy Model
description: Life-size human head and neck anatomy model displaying muscles, blood vessels, nerves, facial structures, and upper thoracic anatomy for medical education and clinical training.

name: Anatomical Hand Muscle Model
description: A detailed anatomical model of the human hand showcasing muscles, tendons, nerves, and ligaments, mounted on a sturdy stand for medical study.

name: Life-Size Human Heart Model
description: A highly detailed, life-size 5-part anatomical model of the human heart. It features a detachable anterior wall, allowing students and medical professionals to explore internal heart chambers, valves, and major coronary blood vessels with great clinical accuracy. Perfect for cardiovascular education and training.

name: Advanced Clinical Skills Training Simulator Kit
description: Comprehensive clinical skills training simulator kit designed for nursing education and medical training. Includes multiple procedure trainers for airway management, injection practice, catheterization, IV access, and patient care skill development.

name: Advanced Adult CPR Training
description: Advanced adult CPR training manikin with an electronic monitoring console for realistic cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), airway management, and emergency life support training.

name: Advanced IV Injection & Venipuncture Training Arm
description: Professional intravenous (IV) injection and venipuncture training arm designed for realistic practice of blood collection, IV cannulation, infusion therapy, and intravenous injection techniques.
